in_sanskrit.name: Khagen
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Khagen एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Khagen is the Sanskrit name for the God of Gods, Indra. He is the king of the gods in Hindu mythology and is known for his power, courage, and victory over evil.
